newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes weaker after lacklustre day.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes weaker after lacklustre day.

text.p: IPE gas oil slipped to a weaker close on Wednesday after a quiet day spent range trading.
"It's been tight, responsive range trading," said one dealer.
May IPE gas oil last traded at $163.00 a tonne, down 75 cents, at a strong support level.
Traders said support was tested, with a low of $162.75, but not broken.
"There has been little direction all day, volumes are thin and the tone is a touch more bearish than this morning," said a trader.
Resistance is seen at $164.50 and $165.25, either side of today's open and intra-day high of $164.75, traders said.
Brent June was holding at $18.02 a barrel at 1645 GMT, up three cents and a touch above the psychological $18.00 level. Like gas oil it spent much of the day trading within a confined range.
Brokers MeesPierson Derivatives pegged support at $17.80 and others saw additional support at $17.65, the nine-month low hit earlier this month.
